name: test-case-creator
description: Dual-agent QA test designer and generator for Azure DevOps and VS Code.

testCaseCreator.areaPath.description: Fallback Azure DevOps area path. Used ONLY when module_analyzer cannot derive area_path from the graph (no product_feature node with parent_product_name metadata). The placeholder default '<dummy>' makes unresolved fallbacks visible in CSV output instead of silently mislabelling test cases.

testCaseCreator.tcIdSchema.featureSlugMa.description: Maximum length of the SHORT_FEATURE slug in generated tc_id values (TC_<SHORT_FEATURE>_<KIND>_<NNN>).

testCaseCreator.tcIdSchema.sequenceFileP.description: Workspace-relative path where TcSequenceStore persists per-feature TC counters across runs.

testCaseCreator.coverageReport.includeAn.description: Include a Behavioral Anomalies section in the coverage report Markdown output.

testCaseCreator.coverageReport.anomalyCr.description: Number of critical-severity anomalies that triggers a top-of-report WARNING banner.

testCaseCreator.maxCorrectionIterations.description: Maximum number of self-correction feedback cycles.

testCaseCreator.mcpTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout (seconds) for each MCP tool call. Increase for large graphs or slow environments. Changes take effect on the next tool call without reloading the extension.

testCaseCreator.validateGraphOnGenerate.description: Run structural graph validation before starting the generation pipeline. Disable to skip the extra MCP round-trip when graph integrity is already known.

testCaseCreator.engineDirectory.description: Absolute path to the Test_case_creator installation directory (the folder containing the engine/ module and .venv/). When set, the extension runs the Python MCP engine from this directory instead of the VS Code workspace root. A Python virtual environment at <engineDirectory>/.venv/ is used automatically if present. Changing this setting takes effect when the MCP server next starts (after a crash or VS Code window reload).

chatParticipants.name: create_tests
chatParticipants.description: Generates structured Azure DevOps test cases and coverage reports.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Analyze rule graph files and generate test case exports.

commands.name: status
commands.description: View current pipeline execution and tool status.
